description: Source code for a Rust module implementing a verifier for temporal logic properties, including classes for managing verification state, property evaluation, and action generation, with embedded tests.

classes.name: StepResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a verification step, including properties, actions, and pending status.

classes.name: Verifier
classes.description: Main class managing verification state, property evaluation, and action generation.

classes.name: Snapshot
classes.description: Data structure for capturing a snapshot with optional name and value.

classes.name: Property
classes.description: Represents a property with a name and evaluation state.

classes.name: PropertyState
classes.description: Enumeration of possible states for a property: initial, residual, true, false.

classes.name: ActionGenerator
classes.description: Encapsulates an action generator with a method to produce action trees.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Initializes a new Verifier instance by executing provided bundle code, setting up JavaScript context, and extracting properties and action generators.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Returns a list of property names currently tracked by the verifier.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Performs a verification step given snapshots and a timestamp, evaluating properties, generating actions, and returning the step result.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates an action tree from the action generator, deserializing JSON output.
